derivation:
by
  apply CoalgHom.coe_linearMap_injective
  exact MonoidAlgebra.lhom_ext' fun g => LinearMap.ext_ring (h g)
explanation: Specialize the coefficient module to R and the linear maps to those underlying F and H. Routine extensionality on R reduces the generator hypotheses to h; injectivity transfers equality back to coalgebra maps.
